tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The frame ground: every title card, diagram scene, end card and the backing behind overlays. Never a pure black.

tokens.name: navy-raised
tokens.usage: Workflow cards, glossary cards, lower-third plates and checkpoint tags sitting on navy.

tokens.name: navy-line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards and the inactive workflow connectors. Not for text.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Primary text and the active node fill. 17:1 on navy, 14:1 on navy-raised.

tokens.name: paper-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: taglines, step descriptions, timecodes. 9:1 on navy.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The one brand accent: the drawn underline in the sting, active connectors, focus rings, chapter rules and large (24px+) labels. 3.9:1 on navy, so never small running text.

tokens.name: blue-text
tokens.usage: Blue for small text on navy (step numbers, link-style labels, the shop label). 8:1 on navy.

tokens.name: blue-tint
tokens.usage: The active-step card fill and the cursor-ring halo. Reads as 'this one' without stealing attention.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid blue fill (chips, the Ready-for-review badge). Use blue fills only at 24px+ text.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Pending and 'processing' states, always with the word or a clock glyph. 9:1 on navy.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Tested result, checkpoint passed, 'You should now see…'. Leans teal so it is never told apart from error by hue alone; always paired with a check glyph or the word. 9:1 on navy.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: The actual error highlight and the recovery card's header, always with the ✕ glyph or the word. 6:1 on navy.

styles.name: promise
styles.usage: The one-line promise or result label in the opening. One per frame, at most two lines.

styles.name: chapter
styles.usage: Chapter names and glossary terms. Floor for 1080p titles; enlarge after a phone test, never shrink.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: You should now see the draft beside the inquiry
styles.usage: Checkpoint tags, lower-third names, step labels. The 32–40px callout band.

styles.name: support
styles.usage: Step descriptions, time-jump labels, lower-third roles. Smallest size allowed on a 16:9 frame.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Check it before anything is sent
styles.usage: Phrase-level captions. Two lines max, paper on a navy plate at 80% so app controls still show through.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Values, node names and expressions read aloud. Hold at least 3 s after reading.

styles.name: value-tag
styles.usage: The single labeled token moving along a workflow trace, and input/output value tags.

styles.name: shorts-hook
styles.usage: First-second headline on a Short. Three to five words.

styles.name: shorts-caption
styles.usage: Phrase-level captions on a Short, inside the vertical safe area, never over app controls.

tokens.name: step-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its word inside a status chip.

tokens.name: step-2
tokens.usage: Padding inside chips and value tags; gap between stacked captions.

tokens.name: step-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on workflow and glossary cards.

tokens.name: step-4
tokens.usage: Gap between workflow nodes on the step map; lower-third inner padding.

tokens.name: step-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its supporting line; connector length minimum.

tokens.name: step-8
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between stacked blocks on a title or end card.

tokens.name: safe-16-9
tokens.usage: Title-safe inset on every 1920×1080 edge (5%). Nothing readable sits outside it.

tokens.name: safe-9-16-x
tokens.usage: Side inset on a 1080×1920 frame.

tokens.name: safe-9-16-top
tokens.usage: Top inset on a Short, clear of the player's title and controls.

tokens.name: safe-9-16-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom inset on a Short, clear of the caption, like and share stack.

tokens.name: endscreen-reserve
tokens.usage: Width reserved on the end card's right side for YouTube's native next-video element. Never paint a fake thumbnail there.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Status chips, value tags, time-jump labels.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Workflow nodes, glossary cards, lower-third plates, error/recovery card.

tokens.name: radius-ring
tokens.usage: The cursor-emphasis ring and the Ready-for-review badge.

duration.note: Frame counts at 30 fps. These are the only durations an episode uses; new motion reuses one of them.

tokens.name: crossfade
tokens.usage: 7 frames (6–8). Between related explanation graphics only; a cut for software-state changes.

tokens.name: cursor-reveal
tokens.usage: 6 frames. Cursor ring in, and 6 frames out after a brief hold.

tokens.name: title-rise
tokens.usage: 9 frames (8–10). Title fade + 16px rise; checkpoint tag and lower-third entrance/exit.

tokens.name: focus-zoom
tokens.usage: 11 frames (9–12). 100→115% push into a prepared crop, then stop.

tokens.name: trace
tokens.usage: 15 frames (12–18). One workflow token along one connector, stopping at the next node.

tokens.name: hold-tag
tokens.usage: Checkpoint tag and lower-third hold (2–4 s, or until read aloud).

tokens.name: sting
tokens.usage: The whole brand sting: wordmark in, blue line draws, out. Never longer.

easing.note: One ease for everything that moves; one for the sting's line.

tokens.name: settle
tokens.usage: Every rise, zoom, trace and ring: fast start, gentle stop. Settle before showing code or a result.

tokens.name: draw
tokens.usage: The blue underline drawing beneath the wordmark in the sting.
